name: agrune-maps-ci
description: Standalone CI scripts for github.com/agrune/maps (PR bot, health check, schema validator). v0.5 MVP self-contained — inline RegistryEntrySchema copy, no @agrune/registry dependency until npm publish in v0.6.

comments.schema-sync: RegistryEntrySchema is inlined in validate-schema.mjs + pr-bot.mjs (DO NOT EDIT without syncing from packages/registry/src/schema.ts + packages/manifest/src/schema.ts). v0.6 TODO: replace inline copy with `"@agrune/registry": "^0.6.0"` once npm publish lands.
comments.playwright-note: playwright is used only by health-check.mjs for snapshot-only DOM probes (no click/fill). Install chromium via `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium` in the workflow step.
